diagnosis.root_cause: Release convergence is blocked by three independent causes: pooled reward retirement hides the pickup root without configure restoring it; the arena couples landmark collision, traversable bounds, and camera visibility through mismatched spatial bindings that transform/framing tuning has not resolved; and dense qualification lacks a collector-independent completed sampling window before the native-renderer gate. The required upgrade-choice hierarchy must also be completed on the reward/build transaction surface.

Do not edit, split, move, duplicate, or perform source surgery on children of the intact authored cemetery package.
Do not change the frozen InputMap, camera-relative CharacterBody3D movement, dash ownership, or the three accepted weapon strategies while repairing these surfaces.

If dense sampling completes with nonzero candidate-owned receipts and native rendering is the only remaining requirement, stop candidate edits and leave recapture and verdict work to the host and Tester.

Keep native_godot_project and host_godot_boot passing; stop the iteration on new fatal import, parse, launch, or recurring runtime errors.

strategy.rationale: Change strategy after repeated transform and qualification treatments: directly restore pooled-instance presentation state, derive gameplay bounds from the existing authored world while isolating landmark visibility from collision, and make dense sampling a persisted self-running window whose diagnostics complete before renderer eligibility is judged.
